export interface Job {requestId: string; name: string;}
export function response(context: ActiveContext, payload: unknown) {return {requestId:context.requestId,payload};}
export function work(context: RequestContext, job: Job) {const child=forkContext(context,'worker');return describeJob(job,child);}

Renamed RequestContext field requestId: string to traceId: string.

Context Construction & Propagation (src/context-factory.ts):

src/response.ts: Returned {requestId: context.traceId, payload}.
src/plugins/plugin0.ts through src/plugins/plugin7.ts: Read context.traceId and returned {requestId: context.traceId, tag: ..., user: context.userId}.

Preserved traceSummary in src/plugins/index.ts and compatibility with all 8 plugins.
Preserved all catalog definitions and consumers under src/catalog/ (record0.ts through record23.ts), retaining their independent RequestContext types and requestId fields.
